operation_details.item: The user does not want SEO keywords, search-optimized headings, or meta descriptions in marketing copy drafts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! What are you working on today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m drafting marketing copy for a new product launch and trying to keep it natural rather than overly optimized.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds like a good approach. Do you already have a rough draft, or are you starting from a blank page?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I have a rough draft. I want the copy to sound confident and specific without stuffing in SEO keywords or using search-optimized headings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. We can focus on a strong point of view, concrete product details, and a rhythm that feels written for people rather than algorithms.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I also don’t want a meta description added to the draft unless I specifically ask for one.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that I do not want SEO keywords, headings optimized for search, or meta descriptions in any marketing copy I ask you to draft.
